name: Red River Bancshares, Inc.
summary: Red River Bancshares, Inc. operates as a bank holding company for Red River Bank that provides banking products and services to commercial and retail customers in the United States. The company offers various deposit products, including checking, saving, money market accounts, and time deposits.
